summary:
Implemented comprehensive customer-wise mobile touch gestures and Ethiopian deal-closing gestures for Agoza Ethiopian Marketplace:
- useTouchGestures: Touch swipe, long-press, and drag-and-drop hook with haptic vibration support.
- CustomerGestureCard: Swipe right to save, swipe up to quick offer, swipe left to pass, and long-press to inspect.
- QuickInspectionModal: 400ms long-press preview with pinch-to-zoom & pan photo canvas, authenticity watermark seal, and 1-tap customer actions.
- PullToRefreshContainer: Pull-down feed gesture with animated Ethiopian coffee roasting Jebena and beans animation.
- HandshakeDealModal: Ethiopian deal-closing ceremony (ደህና ሁን / የንግድ ስምምነት) with contract hash and escrow bridge.
- BunaBlessingToken: Traditional coffee blessing cards (የቡና ምርቃት) and loyalty roasted coffee bean rewards wallet.
- CounterOfferSlider: Tactile price negotiation slider with live Birr math, discount % calculations, and cultural likelihood meter.
